fact_text: The Competition Commission of Pakistan gave conditional approval for PTC's acquisition of Telenor Pakistan; the guest said the approval conditions are acceptable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: The guest said the remaining conditions on the Telenor deal are operational rather than a bottleneck, and the merged accounts may be reviewed for one to one and a half years before final approval.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: Final completion of the Telenor deal still depends on approval from the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) after the competition regulator's conditional approval.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: Telenor Pakistan's EBITDA over the twelve months to November 2025 was about PKR 57 billion, the guest said, above the roughly PKR 55 billion he also cited.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: At the first report on the deal, Telenor Pakistan's EBITDA was about PKR 48 billion and the transaction was priced at about PKR 108 billion, roughly 2.1 to 2.2 times EV/EBITDA.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: On the trailing Telenor EBITDA of about PKR 57 billion, the EV/EBITDA multiple of the Telenor deal fell to about 1.8 times, which the guest said favours PTC.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: Global telecom peers traded at about 6.7 times EV/EBITDA on Bloomberg data the channel pulled, while the Telenor deal was priced at roughly 1.8 to 2 times.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: The guest applied a frontier-market discount of about 25% to the 6.7 times global peer multiple, arriving at a fair EV/EBITDA of about 5 times for Pakistani telecom.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: At about 5 times the combined EBITDA of PTC (over PKR 75 billion) and Telenor (about PKR 55 billion), the guest put PTC's fair value after the acquisition at about PKR 65 per share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: EBITDA approximates operating cash generation before debt costs, so an EV/EBITDA of 2.5 times means a purchase at 100 with EBITDA of 40 pays back in about 2.5 years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: When telecom operators merge, overlapping tower sites need no further build-out, which cuts capital spending and duplicate marketing costs and can lift the merged company's EBITDA.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: Engro Corporation acquired about 10,000 telecom towers for about USD 563 million, which the guest cited as a comparison for tower values within the Telenor deal.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: On the guest's arithmetic, a PKR 108 billion price against Telenor EBITDA of about PKR 60 billion gives a payback of under two years, which he called attractive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: The guest said Telenor Pakistan's EBITDA margin is about double PTC's existing margin, and bringing that business onto PTC's books is the main source of expected value creation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: In a past Pakistani telecom acquisition the guest cited, EBITDA margin was about 40 to 41% at closing and rose to about 47 to 48% soon after.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: The guest expects PTC to move from the third-largest telecom player to the second-largest by market share after the Telenor deal, with the shift showing in the accounts only gradually.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: A lender consortium including IFC, CDC, British International Investment and Silk Road Fund provides about USD 400 million for PTC's Telenor acquisition, which the guest put at about USD 400 million in total.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: PTC reported a loss of about PKR 15 billion, which the guest said has run for two to three years and is driven mainly by interest costs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: PTC's balance sheet carries about PKR 200 billion of interest-bearing debt, which the guest said is the main driver of its losses and leverage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: PTC's 2025 loss included a one-off pension expense of about PKR 6 to 7 billion, similar to a pension case at National Bank, plus exchange losses from currency movements.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: PTC's loss of about PKR 3 per share for the year could turn into roughly PKR 8 billion of combined earnings, about PKR 5 per share, after the Telenor merger, per the guest's projection.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: Average revenue per user (ARPU), the industry's main revenue indicator, rose about 17 to 18% over the two years to November 2025, the guest said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: Telecom cost increases cannot be passed to customers easily, so tariffs rise gradually; the guest cited the Super Card recharge price rising over time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: PTC's sustainable earnings were about PKR 1 to 1.30 per share, and the company paid a dividend of about PKR 1 per share until 2019, the guest said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)

fact_text: The guest expects PTC's numbers to turn positive over the longer term as Telenor's higher margin is consolidated and the one-off pension expense does not recur.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ufone-Telenor Merger to Transform Pakistan's Telecommunication Sector | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-27)
